motion.rule: Use for UI behavior that explains structure or state.

illustrativeAnimation.rule: Use for teaching or emotional clarity; never for required task comprehension.

editorialMotion.rule: Optional and gated by performance and accessibility review.

icons.rule: Use as raw icon material, not as Material Design. Every icon needs a semantic role and accessible-name policy.

charts.rule: Every chart needs title, description, text summary, color-safe encoding, empty state, and keyboard-reachable data access.

maps.rule: Map flows must include geolocation permission, denied state, fallback list, station detail, and route handoff.
